description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Declared that I. L. Mohamed Mahir was selected as the Chairman of the Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a new Chairman for Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral results and declarations at the local government level, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers "election results and declarations" and "electoral commission appointments and decisions."
